2609.17981.title: Encoder Awakening via Adapters: Effective Domain-Adaptive Fine-tuning of Speech-LLMs
2609.17981.paper_summary: Speech Large Language Models (Speech-LLMs), typically built from a pre-trained speech encoder, a modality projector, and an LLM fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA), have shown strong Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance on general-domain speech. However, adapting them to domain-shifted speech, such as child or dialectal speech, remains challenging under limited target-domain data. Given the dominant role of the LLM in Speech-LLMs, with cross-entropy loss applied only at the LLM output, the speech encoder may receive insufficient adaptation to new acoustic conditions. In this paper, we propose Encoder Awakening via Adapters (EAVA), a simple yet effective domain-adaptive fine-tuning method for Speech-LLM-based ASR. First, lightweight adapters are inserted into each encoder layer and trained exclusively, enabling target-domain acoustic knowledge to be incorporated into the encoder while preserving its pre-trained knowledge. Second, the full model is jointly fine-tuned on the target domain with LoRA applied to the LLM. Experiments on three domain-shifted ASR datasets, covering child and dialectal speech, show that EAVA consistently outperforms vanilla fine-tuning and other baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance.
2609.17981.paper_summary_zh: 語音大型語言模型（Speech-LLMs）通常由預訓練的語音編碼器、模態投影器和經低秩適配器（LoRA）微調的LLM組成，在一般領域的自動語音識別（ASR）中表現出色。<lb/>然而，將它們適應於領域轉移的語音，例如兒童或方言語音，在有限的目標領域數據下仍然具有挑戰性。<lb/>考慮到LLM在Speech-LLMs中的主導角色，交叉熵損失僅在LLM輸出時應用，語音編碼器可能無法充分適應新的聲學條件。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了通過適配器喚醒編碼器（Encoder Awakening via Adapters，EAVA），這是一種簡單但有效的基於Speech-LLM的ASR的領域自適應微調方法。<lb/>首先，輕量級適配器被插入到每個編碼器層並專門進行訓練，這使得目標領域的聲學知識能夠被納入編碼器，同時保留其預訓練知識。<lb/>其次，整個模型在目標領域上進行聯合微調，並對LLM應用LoRA。<lb/>在三個領域轉移的ASR數據集上的實驗，涵蓋了兒童和方言語音，顯示EAVA始終優於普通微調和其他基準，實現了新的最先進性能。
